messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up — Zoe's birthday is Tue 5/10 and she's remote that week. Thinking hybrid: cake in the SF office + a photo collage we can print and ship to her home. Who's in? Drop :camera: if you'll send a pic, :cake: if you can contribute to cake/funds, or :money_with_wings: if you'd prefer to Venmo/Stripe.
Liam: :camera: I'll take some candids from last quarter's team offsites and add them. Can someone make a shared folder?
Ava: Good call — created a Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example (add photos by Mon 5/9 EOD). If you want to add a short caption, please include it in the filename like `joe_hikes - caption.txt`.
Maya: :cake: I can pick up a small cake for the office. Any dietary prefs? Vegan/GF options?
Jonas: I can do vegan cupcakes instead of one cake if that helps cover GF/vegan. How many people usually eat at celebrations?
Priya: Usually ~12 in-office on a Tuesday. For the remote collage, can we also do a 5–6 sentence group message on the first page? I'll draft something if someone else volunteers to sign off.
Maya: I'll add a sticky note to the draft message with a couple lines from me.
Liam: Folder permissions set to "Anyone with link can comment" — ping me if you need access. Also uploaded 6 pics (office happy hour + demo day).
Ava: Thanks! For funds: please Venmo @peopleops-bakes or use this one-time Stripe link: https://pay.example.com/zoe-bday (include "Zoe bday" in the note). Target budget $75 for cake + $25 shipping for print/collage.
Jonas: Venmo'd $10. :thumbsup:
Priya: Draft message uploaded as `group_message.md`. Left placeholders for people to add 1–2 lines about Zoe.
people-ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Zoe — Birthday (hybrid)" Tuesday May 10, 3:00 PM PT. Invite sent to #people-ops and calendar attendees.
Ava: Awesome team — if you're sending a photo, please add by Mon so we can finalize layout. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Maya: Also: forks, plates, napkins — I'll bring disposables. If anyone prefers a real plate, bring it along :)
Liam: One more ask — if you're remote and want to drop a short 10–20s video clip, please upload as `videos/yourname.mp4` in the same Drive folder. We'll stitch into the collage.
Priya: Looks great. I'll finalize the print file Tue morning and confirm shipping address with HR.
Ava: Perfect. Tagging @Zoe is off (surprise) so please keep this thread to people helping coordinators. Thank you!
